notifications.push.explain_body: Let us notify you about important updates on your phone, even when the app is closed.
notifications.push.point_quotes: When quotes are created, accepted or declined.
notifications.push.point_todos: When one of your tasks is due.
notifications.push.point_usage: When your plan usage is close to a limit.
notifications.push.explain_footnote: Customer names, amounts and phone numbers are never shown on the lock screen. You can change this anytime in Profile → Preferences.
notifications.push.enabled: Notifications will be sent to this device.
notifications.push.denied: Notification permission was not granted. You can turn it on in your phone's Settings → Otopoly → Notifications.
notifications.push.failed: This device could not be registered for notifications. Please try again later.
notifications.push.pref_hint: Sent to this device while the app is closed. In-app notifications must be on and the phone permission is required.
notifications.push.pref_expo_go: Push notifications don't work in Expo Go. Turn them on in the Otopoly app build.
notifications.push.pref_unavailable: This device doesn't support push notifications.
notifications.link.title: Link
notifications.link.no_access_body: The link belongs to a business your account can't access or that isn't available right now.
notifications.link.switch_failed_body: Something went wrong while switching to the business this link belongs to. Please try again.
notifications.quote_link.title: Quote link
notifications.quote_link.heading: This link is for your customer
notifications.quote_link.body: Your customer can view and respond to the quote in their browser from this link. You can pass the link on to them.
notifications.test.scheduled: It will arrive in {{seconds}} seconds. Put the app in the background and tap the notification.
